phases.label: Web-first intake
phases.notes: Checked OWASP, GitHub, 1Password, and Nx sources before local planning.

phases.label: Memory and root structure review
phases.notes: Reviewed durable instructions, root folder policy, project registry, existing local-only folders, workspace index, and monitor collector behavior.

phases.label: Requirements and spec
phases.notes: Added REQ-WS-074, requirement change/review records, and the sensitive boundary/root architecture spec set.

phases.label: Boundary, docs, tools, and generated maps
phases.notes: Added sensitive boundary config, policy docs, operations guide, workflow, prompt, privacy audit tool, root architecture layers, collector exclusions, and regenerated maps.

phases.label: Verification
phases.notes: Ran config, privacy, structure, docs, naming, memory, workspace index, monitor build, omission, grounding, and evaluation checks.

phases.label: Evaluation and rework
phases.notes: Found and fixed an important traversal gap so the workspace indexer prunes protected local folders before descending into them.

bottleneck_analysis.bottleneck_notes: The main overhead was governance propagation across durable instructions, config, docs, maps, specs, history, monitor snapshots, and close-out evaluation.
improvement_candidates: Create a governance change scaffold that generates paired requirement, spec, history, omission, grounding, and evaluation shells.
Add a CI or pre-push privacy audit hook once the user selects the preferred local/remote enforcement point.
